label: v3-classroom-wipe
pipeline: V3/compose case 3 (a specific thing; the reference supplied by hand, the state manager assumed perfect)
brief: A 10-second widescreen clip, no sound. The attached photo is the classroom and the first frame: the empty room exactly as photographed, morning light through the windows. A caretaker in a plain dark work shirt walks in along the window side with a cloth, bends to a front-row desk and wipes its top in slow strokes, moves to the next desk and wipes it, then straightens and looks down the room. End on the wiped desks shining in the window light.

tools.prompt: Create a 10-second silent classroom clip matching the source image and its widescreen framing. Use the supplied image as the starting frame and strict visual reference: preserve the desk arrangement, right-side teaching platform and green chalkboard, rear windows, furnishings, and morning light reflected on the dark wooden floor. No people are present in the starting frame. One continuous photorealistic shot, with the same caretaker and unchanged classroom throughout. 0–2 seconds: from the original wide composition, a caretaker in a plain dark work shirt, carrying a cleaning cloth, walks into view from offscreen along the window-side aisle toward the nearest front-row desk; begin a gentle forward camera glide. 2–4 seconds: medium-wide framing, the caretaker bent over the brown wooden desktop wipes it with two slow, connected cloth strokes; the camera continues its subtle glide, preserving the window reflections. 4–5 seconds: the caretaker steps sideways to the adjacent front-row desk, cloth still in hand; the camera slides slightly with the movement. 5–7 seconds: bent over the adjacent desktop, the caretaker wipes it with two measured strokes; a restrained forward glide reveals its clean surface catching the daylight. 7–8 seconds: the caretaker straightens, gaze directed down the empty rows; the camera eases into a composition with both cleaned desks prominent in the foreground. 8–10 seconds: hold the final classroom tableau, the caretaker still beyond the two wiped desks, their wooden surfaces softly shining in the window light. Natural morning colour, quiet observational pacing, realistic modest reflections rather than a newly varnished gloss. No additional people, text overlays, or changes to the room layout.

seen.light: Daylight enters through the rear windows, illuminating the empty classroom and reflecting on the polished dark wooden floor. Long fluorescent fixtures hang overhead.
seen.place: An empty classroom with cream upper walls, beige lower walls, rows of wooden student desks and chairs, and a raised teaching platform along the right side. Large rear windows have patterned glass upper panes and clear lower panes showing green foliage outside.

objects.look: Rows of rectangular brown wooden desktops on gray metal frames, paired with brown wooden chairs.
Gray desk on the raised platform near the windows, with a dark-backed chair behind it.
Black monitor, keyboard, and mouse on the teacher's desk.
Large dark green board covering much of the right wall, with faint chalk traces and a narrow bottom ledge.
Narrow board beside the chalkboard, holding several pale sheets of paper.
A bank of small green metal locker doors against the back-left wall.
Several box-shaped window units with pale housings and dark vents, mounted high along the rear windows.
Long fluorescent light fixtures, caged fans, and a pale projector suspended from a black ceiling mount.
Small round clock and dark wall-mounted speakers high on the right wall.
